description: Split live domains: both gayanes.am (old) and new.gayanes.am (new) return HTTP 200 and are indexable.
evidence: curl -I on both domains returned HTTP/2 200; new.gayanes.am has <meta name='robots' content='index, follow'>.
business_impact: Severe dilution of brand authority, split backlinks, and duplicate product/brand indexing.
recommended_fix: Choose gayanes.am as permanent primary domain. Keep new.gayanes.am noindex until cutover, then 301 redirect new.gayanes.am/* -> gayanes.am/* (and keep khohanots.am -> gayanes.am 301).
validation_procedure: Verify curl -I new.gayanes.am returns 301 to gayanes.am and Search Console shows single canonical host.

evidence: curl https://new.gayanes.am/ shows canonical twice: once from GayanesV2/inc/seo.php and once from WP core rel_canonical().
business_impact: Confuses Googlebot canonicalization signals when Yoast SEO is inactive.
recommended_fix: Add remove_action('wp_head', 'rel_canonical') in GayanesV2/inc/seo.php when theme outputs canonical, or activate Yoast SEO.
validation_procedure: View page source and confirm exactly one <link rel='canonical'> tag.

description: Transactional WooCommerce pages are marked index, follow instead of noindex.
evidence: curl https://new.gayanes.am/cart/ returned <meta name='robots' content='index, follow...'>.
business_impact: Wastes crawl budget and risks indexing empty cart/checkout/account pages.
recommended_fix: Output <meta name='robots' content='noindex, follow'> on is_cart(), is_checkout(), is_account_page(), and is_search().
validation_procedure: curl /cart/, /checkout/, /my-account/ and verify noindex meta tag.

description: 404 error pages output 'index, follow', self-referencing canonical, and hreflang tags.
evidence: curl -i https://new.gayanes.am/sitemap_index.xml returned HTTP/2 404 with index, follow and canonical.
business_impact: Google may attempt to index 404 URLs as soft-404s.
recommended_fix: In gv2_output_seo_meta_tags(), return early or output noindex, nofollow on is_404() and suppress canonical/hreflang.
validation_procedure: curl a nonexistent URL and verify HTTP 404 + noindex, nofollow + no canonical.

description: XML sitemap only includes HY URLs; RU and EN translated products/pages are missing from sitemaps.
evidence: Live curl of wp-sitemap-posts-product-1.xml returned only 33 HY product URLs; 0 ?lang=ru or ?lang=en URLs.
business_impact: Slows discovery and indexing of Russian and English catalog pages.
recommended_fix: Include all language URLs in XML sitemap (ideally via clean /ru/ and /en/ URLs or Yoast/GM sitemap provider) and disable wp-sitemap-users-1.xml.
validation_procedure: Inspect XML sitemap and verify all 99 product URLs + categories + pages are listed.

description: Hreflang uses query-param URLs, lacks x-default, and uses en-US/ru-RU instead of en/ru or en-AM/ru-AM.
evidence: Live <head> shows hreflang='en-US', 'hy', 'ru-RU' with ?lang= params and no x-default.
business_impact: Suboptimal regional targeting (US/RU instead of Armenia) and weaker URL signals.
recommended_fix: Switch Gemini Multilingual to subdirectory mode (/ru/, /en/) if permalinks allow, add x-default pointing to HY, and use hy-AM, ru-AM, en-AM (or hy, ru, en).
validation_procedure: Validate reciprocal hreflang + x-default in source and Search Console.

business_impact: Exposes admin username slug for brute-force enumeration and creates thin author archive.
recommended_fix: Disable wp-sitemap users provider via wp_sitemaps_add_provider filter and noindex author archives.

description: LocalBusiness / FoodEstablishment schema is suppressed when Gayanes_Core is active, and seo.php hardcodes https://gayanes.am/.
evidence: Code inspection: GayanesV2/inc/seo.php line 134 returns early; class-seo-schema.php only outputs Organization (not FoodEstablishment/LocalBusiness).
business_impact: Loss of local Armenia/Yerevan map pack & rich LocalBusiness eligibility.
recommended_fix: Upgrade Gayanes_Core\SEO_Schema::get_organization_schema() to FoodEstablishment/LocalBusiness with full Yerevan address, phone, geo, openingHours, and areaServed.
validation_procedure: Validate homepage JSON-LD in Google Rich Results Test.

description: WooCommerce filter/orderby/add-to-cart query params lack robots/canonical hardening; /shop/ TTFB is 0.86s.
evidence: curl /shop/ TTFB=0.86s (vs 0.27s cached home) and ?orderby=price can generate duplicate crawlable URLs.
business_impact: Crawl waste on faceted/sort URLs and slower category/shop TTFB.
recommended_fix: Ensure LiteSpeed Cache warms /shop/ and category archives; set noindex on ?orderby= / ?s= / ?add-to-cart=.
validation_procedure: Measure /shop/ TTFB < 0.30s and confirm noindex on sort/search URLs.

description: 15+ products have missing images in DB (placeholder), missing DB ALT text, missing SKUs on imported items, and Yoast SEO is inactive.
evidence: DB audit: 33 HY/RU/EN groups inspected; several imported products lack featured images, SKUs, and custom meta descriptions.
business_impact: Lower CTR in SERPs, missed Google Images traffic, and incomplete Product schema.
recommended_fix: Upload real product photos, populate _wp_attachment_image_alt in all 3 languages, assign unique SKUs, and configure Yoast or theme SEO meta templates.
validation_procedure: Re-run catalog audit and verify 0 missing images/ALTs/SKUs.

description: 12 OTF font files (~1MB total) + unminified 152KB main.css + 29KB app.js loaded.
evidence: ls -lh showed 12 .otf files (33-45KB each) and 152KB main.css.
business_impact: Increases mobile FCP/LCP payload; OTF is ~30-50% larger than WOFF2.
recommended_fix: Convert GAA Gayane fonts to WOFF2, preload primary weights, and minify main.css/app.js in build.
validation_procedure: Verify Lighthouse Mobile LCP < 2.5s and WOFF2 usage.

description: Category descriptions are empty on most product_cat terms; blog/recipe content is minimal.
evidence: audit_cats.json shows empty description fields; only a small number of blog posts exist.
business_impact: Missed informational & high-intent category ranking opportunities.
recommended_fix: Publish unique 150-250 word SEO category descriptions in HY/RU/EN and execute 90-day recipe/blog calendar.
validation_procedure: Track impressions/clicks for category & blog keywords in GSC.
